name: Governed organs
purpose: Verify bounded authority, category integrity, protocol stability, held-out improvement, lineage, regression, rollback and resource budgets across reasoning, physics, ecology, game and other organ families.

baseline_claims.need: Observation, proposal, promotion and tool authority remain separate.
An organ remains inside its declared category and cannot silently occupy an incompatible slot.
Inputs, outputs, identity and state schemas remain stable or migrate visibly.
Claimed learning improvement survives a held-out exam.
Novel structures outside the exam are named for steward review.
Baseline, challenger, data, decisions and regressions remain traceable.
Promotion can be held or rolled back without erasing lineage.
Heartbeat, compute, memory and thermal budgets are bounded.
